global.title: Global Constants
global.summary: Built-in units, mathematical and physical constants, and metric scale factors available without an import.
global.importLine: # Global constants are available without an import

sections.title: SI Base Units
sections.source: BIPM, The International System of Units (SI Brochure), 9th edition, version 4.01, June 2026.
sections.exactness: Exact SI unit definitions represented as rational quantities.

entries.description: The SI base unit of length.
entries.value: A unit-magnitude quantity with the Meter dimension. All three spellings are equal.

entries.description: The SI base unit of time.
entries.value: A unit-magnitude quantity with the Second dimension. All three spellings are equal.

entries.description: The SI base unit of mass.
entries.value: A unit-magnitude quantity with the Kilogram dimension. All three spellings are equal.

entries.description: The SI base unit of electric current.
entries.value: A unit-magnitude quantity with the Ampere dimension. All three spellings are equal.

entries.description: The SI base unit of thermodynamic temperature.
entries.value: A unit-magnitude quantity with the Kelvin dimension. All three spellings are equal.

entries.description: The SI base unit for amount of substance.
entries.value: A unit-magnitude quantity with the Mole dimension. All three spellings are equal.

entries.description: The SI base unit of luminous intensity.
entries.value: A unit-magnitude quantity with the Candela dimension. All three spellings are equal.

sections.title: SI Derived Units
sections.source: BIPM, The International System of Units (SI Brochure), 9th edition, version 4.01, June 2026.
sections.exactness: Exact coherent SI definitions represented as rational quantities.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of frequency.
entries.value: One reciprocal second, with dimension Second^-1.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of force.
entries.value: One kilogram meter per second squared.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of pressure.
entries.value: One kilogram per meter-second squared.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of energy.
entries.value: One kilogram meter squared per second squared.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of power.
entries.value: One joule per second.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of electric charge.
entries.value: One ampere second.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of electric potential.
entries.value: One kilogram meter squared per second cubed per ampere.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of electrical capacitance.
entries.value: One ampere squared second to the fourth per kilogram meter squared.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of electrical resistance.
entries.value: One kilogram meter squared per second cubed per ampere squared.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of electrical conductance.
entries.value: The reciprocal of an ohm.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of magnetic flux.
entries.value: One kilogram meter squared per second squared per ampere.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of magnetic flux density.
entries.value: One kilogram per second squared per ampere.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of electrical inductance.
entries.value: One kilogram meter squared per second squared per ampere squared.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of luminous flux.
entries.value: A Candela-dimension quantity; solid angle is dimensionless in the runtime model.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of illuminance.
entries.value: One lumen per square meter.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of radioactive activity.
entries.value: One reciprocal second.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of absorbed radiation dose.
entries.value: One square meter per second squared.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of equivalent radiation dose.
entries.value: One square meter per second squared.

entries.description: The SI derived unit of catalytic activity.
entries.value: One mole per second.

sections.exactness: Exact definitions represented as rational quantities.

entries.description: A metric unit of volume.
entries.value: Exactly one thousandth of a cubic meter.

entries.description: A time unit equal to 60 seconds.

entries.description: A time unit equal to 60 minutes.

entries.description: A time unit equal to 24 hours.

sections.title: Metric Units
sections.source: BIPM, The International System of Units (SI Brochure), 9th edition, version 4.01, June 2026.
sections.exactness: Exact decimal definitions represented as rational quantities.

entries.description: A metric volume equal to one thousandth of a liter.
entries.value: Exactly 10^-6 cubic meters.

entries.description: The volume of a cube whose sides are one centimeter.
entries.value: Exactly 10^-6 cubic meters; equal to Milliliter. `cc` is retained as an Osiris convenience alias.

entries.description: A metric mass equal to one thousandth of the kilogram.
entries.value: Exactly 10^-3 kilograms.

entries.description: The tonne, explicitly named to avoid an ambiguous unqualified ton.
entries.value: Exactly 1,000 kilograms.

entries.description: A non-SI metric area used for land measurement.
entries.value: Exactly 10,000 square meters.

entries.description: A decimal submultiple of the meter used for atomic-scale lengths.
entries.value: Exactly 10^-10 meters.

sections.title: Customary Length
sections.source: NIST Special Publication 811, 2008 edition, Web version 3.2, Appendix B; the international inch is exactly 0.0254 m.
sections.exactness: Exact international definitions represented as rational quantities.

entries.description: The international inch. The reserved keyword `in` is deliberately not an alias.
entries.value: Exactly 0.0254 meters.

entries.description: The international foot, not the former U.S. survey foot.
entries.value: Exactly 12 inches, or 0.3048 meters.

entries.description: The international yard.
entries.value: Exactly 3 feet, or 0.9144 meters.

entries.description: The international statute mile.
entries.value: Exactly 1,760 yards, or 1,609.344 meters.

entries.description: The international nautical mile adopted by the International Hydrographic Conference.
entries.value: Exactly 1,852 meters.

entries.description: The international acre based on the international foot.
entries.value: Exactly 43,560 square feet, or 4,046.8564224 square meters.

entries.description: The U.S. liquid gallon. Imperial and U.S. dry gallons are intentionally not implied.
entries.value: Exactly 231 cubic inches, or 0.003785411784 cubic meters.

entries.value: Exactly one quarter of a U.S. liquid gallon.

entries.description: A U.S. liquid pint.
entries.value: Exactly one eighth of a U.S. liquid gallon.

entries.description: A U.S. customary cup.
entries.value: Exactly one sixteenth of a U.S. liquid gallon.

entries.description: A U.S. fluid ounce; the qualified name avoids confusion with mass ounces.

entries.description: A U.S. customary tablespoon.
entries.value: Exactly one half U.S. fluid ounce.

entries.description: A U.S. customary teaspoon.
entries.value: Exactly one third U.S. tablespoon.

entries.description: The imperial gallon, explicitly separated from the unqualified U.S. liquid gallon.
entries.value: Exactly 4.54609 liters.

entries.description: An imperial quart.
entries.value: Exactly one quarter of an imperial gallon.

entries.description: An imperial pint.
entries.value: Exactly one eighth of an imperial gallon.

entries.description: An imperial fluid ounce.
entries.value: Exactly one 160th of an imperial gallon.

sections.title: Customary Mass
sections.source: NIST Special Publication 811, 2008 edition, Web version 3.2, Appendix B; pound values are avoirdupois.
sections.exactness: Exact definitions represented as rational quantities.

entries.description: The avoirdupois ounce.
entries.value: Exactly one sixteenth of an avoirdupois pound, or 0.028349523125 kilograms.

entries.description: The international avoirdupois pound.
entries.value: Exactly 0.45359237 kilograms.

entries.description: The stone used for body mass in the United Kingdom and Ireland.
entries.value: Exactly 14 avoirdupois pounds.

entries.description: The U.S. short ton. No unqualified `ton` alias is provided.

sections.title: Astronomical Units
sections.source: BIPM SI Brochure 9th edition version 4.01; IAU 2012 Resolution B2 for the astronomical unit and IAU 2015 Resolution B2 for the parsec.
sections.exactness: Defined units are exact rational quantities except Parsec, whose irrational definition is stored at the documented decimal precision; Dalton uses the 2022 CODATA concise measured value.

entries.description: The astronomical unit used for solar-system distances.
entries.value: Exactly 149,597,870,700 meters.

entries.description: The distance light travels in vacuum during one Julian year.
entries.value: Exactly 9,460,730,472,580,800 meters from the exact speed of light and Julian year definitions.

entries.description: The IAU parsec, defined as 648,000/π astronomical units.
entries.value: Stored as the published decimal 3.0856775814913673e16 meters, without a binary-float conversion.

entries.description: The dalton, equal to the unified atomic mass unit.
entries.value: The 2022 CODATA concise value 1.66053906892e-27 kilograms; this is a measured value.

sections.title: Small Time Units
sections.source: BIPM SI Brochure 9th edition version 4.01; the Julian year is exactly 365.25 days by IAU convention.
sections.exactness: Exact rational quantities. These globals are quantities; qualified std/time constants are duration values.

entries.description: One billionth of an SI second.
entries.value: Exactly 10^-9 seconds. `time.nanosecond` is the separate qualified duration constant.

entries.description: One millionth of an SI second.
entries.value: Exactly 10^-6 seconds. `time.microsecond` is the separate qualified duration constant.

entries.description: One thousandth of an SI second.
entries.value: Exactly 10^-3 seconds. `time.millisecond` is the separate qualified duration constant.

entries.description: The uniform Julian year used in astronomy.
entries.value: Exactly 365.25 days, or 31,557,600 seconds; it is not a calendar year.

sections.title: Speed and Frequency
sections.source: NIST SP 811 (2008) conversion factors and the exact international nautical mile; rpm is a count of revolutions per minute.

entries.description: One international nautical mile per hour.
entries.value: Exactly 463/900 meters per second.

entries.description: One kilometer per hour.
entries.value: Exactly 5/18 meters per second.

entries.description: One international mile per hour.
entries.value: Exactly 1,397/3,125 meters per second.

entries.description: One counted revolution per minute.
entries.value: Exactly 1/60 reciprocal second. It is frequency, not the 2π-valued Revolution angle scale.

entries.description: Pound-force per square international inch.

entries.description: The energy delivered by one kilowatt for one hour.

entries.description: One sixtieth of an arcminute.
entries.value: The binary64 result of Pi / 648,000.

entries.description: One full turn of plane angle.
entries.value: The binary64 result of 2 × Pi.

sections.title: Physical Constants
sections.source: NIST 2022 CODATA recommended values, database version 9.0 (May 2024). Parenthesized CODATA uncertainties are described in each measured entry; Osiris stores the published concise central value.
sections.exactness: Exact defined constants and measured or irrational-derived published decimals are identified per entry.

entries.description: The speed of light in vacuum.
entries.value: Exactly 299,792,458 meters per second by the SI definition.

entries.description: The Planck constant.
entries.value: Exactly 6.62607015e-34 kilogram meter squared per second by the SI definition.

entries.description: The reduced Planck constant.
entries.value: The published decimal 1.054571817e-34 kilogram meter squared per second for the exact irrational definition Planck/(2π).

entries.description: The Avogadro constant.
entries.value: Exactly 6.02214076e23 reciprocal moles by the SI definition.

entries.description: The Boltzmann constant.
entries.value: Exactly 1.380649e-23 kilogram meter squared per second squared per kelvin by the SI definition.

entries.description: The molar gas constant.
entries.value: Exactly 8.31446261815324 kilogram meter squared per second squared per mole-kelvin, the product of exact Avogadro and Boltzmann definitions.

entries.description: The elementary electric charge.
entries.value: Exactly 1.602176634e-19 ampere seconds by the SI definition.

entries.description: The Newtonian constant of gravitation.
entries.value: The 2022 CODATA measured concise value 6.67430e-11 cubic meters per kilogram second squared; standard uncertainty is 0.00015e-11.

entries.description: Standard acceleration due to gravity.
entries.value: Exactly 9.80665 meters per second squared by conventional definition.

entries.description: The dimensionless fine-structure constant.
entries.value: The 2022 CODATA measured concise value 7.2973525643e-3, with relative standard uncertainty 1.6e-10.

entries.description: The magnetic permeability of vacuum.
entries.value: The 2022 CODATA measured concise value 1.25663706127e-6 newtons per ampere squared; standard uncertainty is 0.00000000020e-6.

entries.description: The electric permittivity of vacuum.
entries.value: The 2022 CODATA measured concise value 8.8541878188e-12 farads per meter; standard uncertainty is 0.0000000014e-12.

entries.description: The electron rest mass.
entries.value: The 2022 CODATA measured concise value 9.1093837139e-31 kilograms; standard uncertainty is 0.0000000028e-31.

entries.description: The proton rest mass.
entries.value: The 2022 CODATA measured concise value 1.67262192595e-27 kilograms; standard uncertainty is 0.00000000052e-27.

entries.description: The neutron rest mass.
entries.value: The 2022 CODATA measured concise value 1.67492750056e-27 kilograms; standard uncertainty is 0.00000000085e-27.

entries.description: The unified atomic mass constant.
entries.value: The 2022 CODATA measured concise value 1.66053906892e-27 kilograms; standard uncertainty is 0.00000000052e-27.

entries.description: Electric charge per mole of elementary charges.
entries.value: Exactly 96,485.3321233100184 coulombs per mole, the product of exact elementary-charge and Avogadro definitions.

entries.description: The Stefan–Boltzmann proportionality constant for black-body radiant exitance.
entries.value: The 2022 CODATA derived value 5.670374419e-8 watts per square meter kelvin to the fourth; the displayed decimal terminates with an ellipsis in CODATA.

entries.description: The Rydberg constant for an infinitely heavy nucleus.
entries.value: The 2022 CODATA measured concise value 10,973,731.568157 reciprocal meters; standard uncertainty is 0.000012 reciprocal meters.

entries.description: The Bohr radius.
entries.value: The 2022 CODATA measured concise value 5.29177210544e-11 meters; standard uncertainty is 0.00000000082e-11.

entries.description: The Bohr magneton.
entries.value: The 2022 CODATA measured concise value 9.2740100657e-24 joules per tesla; standard uncertainty is 0.0000000029e-24.

entries.description: The nuclear magneton.
entries.value: The 2022 CODATA measured concise value 5.0507837393e-27 joules per tesla; standard uncertainty is 0.0000000016e-27.

entries.description: An argument is missing, malformed, or outside the accepted domain.
The requested resource or value does not exist.
An operation tried to create a resource that already exists.
The caller is known but is not allowed to perform the operation.

A required service or resource is temporarily unavailable.
The operation did not complete before its deadline.
The operation stopped because cancellation was requested.
The operation conflicts with the current state of a resource.
A finite quota, capacity, or other managed resource has been exhausted.
The operation could not obtain the memory it needed.
A value or position falls outside the valid range.
The requested operation is not supported for this input or backend.
The requested operation is recognized but has not been implemented.
